vibe_rationale: Shop-run custom bike show with art, live music and stunt shows; strong community and curation, though heavily OEM-branded and single-scene.
fit_notes: Broad crowd, young and old, that includes non-riders drawn by art and music, but motorcycle culture has weak wellness adjacency. Forty-eight listed sponsors, mostly motorcycle makers and including a presenting insurer, with an email contact and no partnership page. A demo or hospitality role would suit, and the 2027 venue is still uncertain. US-based.
